evaluation_improvement_plan_007.evidence: Section 41.1.4 establishes a Permanent Teacher Intervention Component to assist permanent teachers with less than satisfactory skills. Triggers include an “unsatisfactory” rating on the prior year’s summary evaluation or “needs improvement” for two or more consecutive years. Support includes a Peer Coach and Individual Learning Plan. Consequences after review include that if a teacher “Does Not Meet Standards,” “either non-reelection or termination is possible.”

evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: Section 41.1.1.10 states that if a teacher “Does Not Meet Standards,” “either non-reelection or termination is possible.” Section 37.1 gives summer school priority to teachers with “satisfactory or better evaluations.” Section 29.1.1.2 requires evaluations rated “better than satisfactory” for probationary appointment eligibility. Section 28.8.4 gives priority for open positions to substitutes without an “unsatisfactory evaluation.”
